components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: The page is one continuous ledger. The same Araiven trade plan reappears at every layer (the ask, the score, the gates, the risk veto, the approval), set as rows, hairline rules, tape-style logs and tabular figures. Where a conventional page would use cards, this one uses ruled rows. Where it would use a gradient CTA, it floods one whole section with Amber.
keyCharacteristics: Ledger rows and 1px Stone rules before any boxed container.
Amber is the only chromatic accent besides gain green and loss red, which appear only on data.
One full-bleed Amber field on the page, and it is the risk guard.
Figures are tabular mono; headings are tightly tracked Bricolage.
Product window and chat use realistic, illustrative data.
Depth comes from tonal steps of Gunmetal, not glow.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Exactly one section is flooded with Amber, and it is the one about the user's drawdown cap. On it, text is Gunmetal ink, focus ring flips to ink, and no other color appears.

rules.name: The Amber Is Action Rule
rules.body: Amber marks what the user can do or what is currently selected or lit. It is never decorative fill, border tint on idle cards, or gradient.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only on market data and verdict chips.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Mono is used only for figures, prices, times, scores, tickers and status chips. Prose, buttons and headings never use it.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline letter-spacing stays between -0.015em and -0.06em; large size and tight tracking are the voice.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with 1px Stone-alpha rules or a tonal step. A shadow is reserved for the hero window.

rules.name: The Visible By Default Rule
rules.body: Content must be readable without the entrance animation; keyframes only supply the entrance (hero) and reveal state is added by script.

dos: Do build new sections as ledger rows with 1px Stone-alpha rules (--rv-line 12%, --rv-line-soft 8%) before reaching for a card.
Do keep Amber (#f59e0b) for actions, selection and the single risk field; use Amber Lift (#fbbf24) for Amber text on dark.
Do set every figure, ticker, time and score in Red Hat Mono with tabular numerals.
Do label demo figures as illustrative, and pair green and red with a sign or label (PRODUCT.md).
Do keep the 2px Amber focus ring and honor prefers-reduced-motion for every new animation.
donts: Don't add a second full-bleed Amber section, gradient fills, glows or icon tiles.
Don't use Red Hat Mono for prose, buttons or headings.
Don't apply these --rv-* tokens to the app dashboard; its older tokens in src/theme and styles.css are separate until a migration is decided.
Don't invent testimonials, logos, user counts or performance claims; none exist (PRODUCT.md).
Don't replace the hairline separation with drop shadows on rows or cards.
